audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the already-audited mirror and with their own whys[]: win[2] said Skill where the why says level 3 is still his, win[3] said Darius where the why says you flip at 4, and win[6] said Darius where the why calls two items a skill coinflip. whys[4] also described level 5 while sitting on the Level 6 row.
audit.why: The darius__wukong mirror settled this chart: win[2] to Darius, win[3] to Wukong, win[6] to Skill, and Level 6 deliberately left at Skill because Cyclone interrupting the Guillotine cast and a Guillotine reset erasing your lead genuinely cut both ways. Restating from your side gives Darius / Darius / Darius / Wukong / Skill / Darius / Skill.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as matched pairs; whys[4] re-pointed at Level 6 and stated as even, matching the mirror's wording.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page is built on 'engage when Apprehend is down' and never once says how long that is.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — the longest cooldown in his kit by a wide margin and the reason level 4-5 is your window at all. Decimate is 9/8/7/6/5s and Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s with a cooldown refresh on a kill. Those numbers turn 'trade around his pull' into something countable.
audit.corrected: 26s Apprehend into phases[2].why, phases[3].why, phases[5].why, dosFull[0].d and the cooldown block; 9s Decimate and 120s Guillotine into the cooldown block, phases[4].why and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is described only as a pull, and the page recommends Plated Steelcaps and an armour-shred pattern without noting what beats armour here.
audit.why: Apprehend PASSIVELY makes Darius's physical damage ignore a percentage of your armour — the active pull is only half the ability. And Noxian Guillotine deals true damage. So the two things that actually kill you both bypass the stat the build is stacking, which is a fact the reader needs when deciding whether to buy more armour or more health.
audit.corrected: The armour penetration stated in dosFull[0].d and the cooldown block; Guillotine's true damage stated in the cooldown block and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] writes "Reset Guillotine" — the packet flagged it against "noxian guillotine".
audit.why: The full name is Noxian Guillotine. The shortened form is not strictly wrong, but the packet's near-miss check will keep flagging it and the full name fits in the same space.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[2] uses the full ability name.

edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 but his pull-into-Decimate still beats your kit at 3 — stay outside 535 range and farm.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You flip at 4: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, so once he spends it you have a full rotation of free trades before it returns.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Darius's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is 120s at rank 1 and refreshes on a kill — Cyclone interrupts the leap, but a reset erases your lead.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item beats your Black Cleaver — engage only in the 26s after Apprehend is spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Darius carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in it's a coinflip: your Cyclone interrupt against a Guillotine that refreshes on a kill. Land yours first.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — his all-in start, and it passively pierces your armour. - Decimate: 9s, and the outer blade heals him. - Noxian Guillotine: 120s true damage, refreshed by a kill.

edits.before: His all-in start. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 26s at rank 1, and it passively cuts through your armour anyway.

edits.before: You keep 5 as Crushing Blow shreds him while his heal is denied and your all-in is online.
edits.after: Level 6 is even: Cyclone interrupts his Guillotine, but a reset undoes your lead.

edits.before: Reset Guillotine on a low target to snowball
edits.after: Reset Noxian Guillotine on a low target

notes: Restated from the mirror rather than re-derived — including its deliberate decision to leave Level 6 at Skill, which the packet chart disagrees with. The one thing neither side's page said: Apprehend's PASSIVE armour penetration, which matters because this entry recommends Plated Steelcaps and an armour-shred trading pattern while both of his kill tools (pierced physical damage, true-damage Guillotine) route around armour.
